t: A cloud AI platform with many teacher tools and teacher-led student activities.
steps: Find MagicSchool on its official site and sign up for a free teacher account.
Read the privacy policy and ask IT to review it.
Do not enter student names or identifying details into the AI tools.
Try one tool, such as a rubric or a lesson plan.
Review every output before using it with students.
Ask the district about a paid plan and a data privacy agreement for student tools.
Set up SSO and rostering with IT.
